title: Limitations

---

Not currently supported. None of these are structural, just not built
yet.

## Embeds aren't transcluded

Obsidian's embed syntax (a `!` before the double brackets, embedding
another note or an image inline) is not specially handled. The wikilink
pattern matches the bracketed part regardless of a leading `!`, so an
embed of a real page becomes a broken image tag pointing at that page's
URL: a page, rendered as if it were an image, which fails to
load. An embed of a target that doesn't exist is just another unresolved
wikilink warning, same as [[Wikilinks and Aliases|any other dangling link]].

## Full-path wikilink targets

Only a page's `title:`, its filename stem, and `also-known-as:` resolve.
A folder-qualified target does not. See [[Wikilinks and Aliases]] for the
registry mechanics this follows from, and how duplicate names are handled
instead.

## Inline code spans

A real single-backtick code span like `` `[[literal example]]` `` renders
correctly. It stays as plain code text in the page, not a broken link, and
the pre-render scan skips it the same way it skips fenced code blocks, so
no spurious unresolved-wikilink warning is printed either.
